result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **HubSpot or Pipedrive**\. The best choice depends on whether you want an all-round customer management system or something focused on managing sales.

Here are my top picks for 2026.

## Best CRM platforms for small teams

![21 Best CRM Enterprise Software Reviewed For 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/E3oBllJko6DSkC1G-YxonkpSd-C9EJzphRnffFc13dKq176hHlHIBef_KD3uo3Rj4h1fcldcCQ6woqfNfkWWmNW8Rs1_qiHKjMrnT7yrtNAkkpWII-RvqcBN_-0EERClJKgsbj3AQum9lvjpnXVV_ofvoY4dYvM4uvHF3Aza7RJS9SAW_-O73lSaxuQ1_7Sl?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. HubSpot CRM**

(Best overall)

- Free entry-level CRM.
- Contact and customer management.
- Sales pipelines and task reminders.
- Email tracking and marketing integrations.

Best if you want sales, marketing and customer management together.

[HubSpot website](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm)

---

![Pipedrive Culture | Comparably](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/LL0qs5ZEn5bajHXZMpCmlJ4Q8G8bG-uCRPdMDaugOTZ5M83xr5SdfSJtpaTsU9pV5XZU_j6tdK98aLeb5eQtmf3jAulEyqWXtwu_NCqqantmt4RgTKgW92e5jqAqiwI5Gvz6HoJSFRLf0DV2WCKF0F5we1qdhyYgERFOvFPWSwO__wWT47lukE3R9cSOeuBr?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Pipedrive**

(Best for sales teams)

- Excellent visual sales pipeline.
- Easy to see where every deal stands.
- Follow-up reminders and automation.
- Straightforward to learn.

Best if your team spends most of its time generating leads and closing deals.

[Pipedrive website](https://www.pipedrive.com/)

---

![TheProwess | Zoho CRM'de Yeni Dönem: Eski Arayüz 15 Temmuz'da Tamamen Kaldırılıyor](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/mhOzD_IXTeMyjegHs7_31H-nZlvGoIQWY2PfiTmHpwuQOA09A9NutmTAM8TWT2HF-7JryptkgV-lS_xHcaI7d43ujbBUTvqfxj-z3nk-gdRQr3-Ei-qigHIPik-T14ytWC4EuYLl0he93dU9qCw5sHTS1LPdprZuUjTWv0UHX5wzcmxSTdtKBrPPwq-xdGBE?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho CRM**

- Good value for money.
- Customisable sales processes.
- Workflow automation.
- Broad integrations.

Best if you want lots of functionality without spending a fortune.

[Zoho website](https://www.zoho.com/crm/)

---

![Descargar Freshsales CRM varies-with-device para Web Apps - Filehippo.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ymGWkXtkAC7MoWysGML3OKgHF9O0MPKH1PfAAeDjk1aaZrRWaVBb9r5y-Kf_8j4xYqKU0KB7QvzLaYT0HE0Vv7VVhtrsyXiqQzkmNrQWCEXFxliHIByLJsgnf2ztG74VQ6KpL_qyhXQE--CUkaD3WIbFGDInuBn5hMKNEjmTwahJ5xR1Qf4y9c43huoiOovk?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Freshsales**

- Built-in phone, email and chat features.
- Lead scoring and sales automation.
- Good entry-level pricing.

Best if your team handles lots of customer enquiries and outbound sales.

[Freshsales website](https://www.freshworks.com/crm/sales/)

---

![The Best CRM Software for Designers, Artists & Real Estate Agents](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aGZxaud4q3cvW6D4kplicJbw3lj5aY7OkJMu751HNJvN-Z6fTsofY1fI2lv3t2JuSrlAUNpIZbK_EkYz81V6l6wGjzjCvur9YwAO1MVb4x2YNszRWgZ7Gssj0YyDH_afSDs3GAZUOL97SxBJEnHLtAcWL7f7jQA1UIE7oJOJDcp8j8QmSmrvpYYVDbcNlTWF?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Capsule CRM**

- Simple contact management.
- Sales opportunities and pipelines.
- Customer history and task tracking.
- Particularly suitable for smaller UK businesses.

Best if you want something straightforward without too many complicated features.

[Capsule website](https://capsulecrm.com/)

## Quick comparison

| CRM | Best for | Starting point |
|--------|--------|--------|
| HubSpot | All-round CRM | Free |
| Pipedrive | Sales management | £14/user/mo |
| Zoho | Value and features | £12/user/mo |
| Freshsales | Sales and communications | £7/user/mo |
| Capsule | Simplicity | Free tier |


Prices are indicative UK starting prices, generally with annual billing. Check the current plans and user limits before purchasing. ## My recommendation

If I were choosing a CRM for a small business, I'd shortlist\:

- **HubSpot** for an all-round business CRM.
- **Pipedrive** for a sales-focused team.
- **Capsule** for simplicity.

## Three questions to help me narrow it down

I'd like to recommend the right system rather than just the most popular one.

**1\. How many people will use the CRM?**
